Early beta. Helper for the ARR Zodiac relic line that works next to ZodiacBuddy Reborn. Infuses the materia you hold into your Sphere Scrolls, hands your relics to Jalzahn for each upgrade, and farms Light and Mahatmas through AutoDuty, with Remon attaching the next Mahatma. Optional: AutoDuty for the farms, vnavmesh for walking to the NPCs, Lifestream for inn rooms.

search.website_text:
# Kyuuso Dalamud Plugins Repository

Custom repository of plugins for FFXIV / Dalamud.

## How to add this repository in Dalamud

1. In game, type `/xlsettings` in chat to open Dalamud settings.
2. Navigate to the **Experimental** tab.
3. In the **Custom Plugin Repositories** section, paste the following URL into the text box:
   ```text
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kyuuso/dalamud-plugins/main/pluginmaster.json
   ```
4. Click the `+` button to add it, then click **Save and Close**.
5. Open the plugin installer with `/xlplugins`.
6. Search for the plugin in the list and click **Install**.

## Available Plugins

- **Eureka Suite**: all-in-one Eureka suite with aggro radars, live tracker sync, bunny helpers and Logos & Loot errands.
- **Bozja Suite** (early beta): Save the Queen field operations helper with a critical engagement tracker and a fragment planner with market prices.
- **Zodiac Helper** (early beta): companion for ZodiacBuddy Reborn that automates the Novus, Nexus, Zodiac and Zeta steps of the ARR relics.

- Trips to an NPC wait up to 3 minutes for a duty or cutscene to end before teleporting.
- Lure leves (Don't Forget to Cry): a prime location that lures nothing within 8 seconds is skipped. It used the lure on the same wrong spot every 5 seconds.
- New "Dungeon coffers" option in the Debug tab for book, Braves and unlock dungeons: boss coffers only (default), every coffer, no coffers, or your own DAD/AutoDuty loot settings.
- FATE combat after a dungeon: AutoDuty/DAD turn the BossMod AI off and clear its autorotation preset. /vbmai on is now sent again after each zone change, and without Rotation Solver your last preset (or VBM Default) is set for the fight and cleared after it.
- Atma FATEs inside the U'Ghamaro Mines are done on the ground; the mount stays off past the entrance.
- Jalzahn's furnace is used from (445.9, -66.3), where it worked by hand. When WigglyQuest hovers at Gerolt or the furnace, it lands and walks in.
- The "Do you really want to trade a high-quality item?" prompt is answered on quests Zodiac Helper started.
- Main tab: materia and the class weapon read "autopilot" when market buying is on.
